description: Pharmaceutical tablet NIR calibration-transfer engineering benchmark; not Chinese medicinal-herb data

metadata_sources.role: Original dataset provider; URL currently not retrievable through the web tool.
Davies and Fearn, 2007; assay is mg/tablet; NIR 600–1898 nm; the 40 validation tablets represent two production batches.

Package dataset documentation: corresponding tablets on two instruments, nominal active ingredient 200 mg/tablet, signal log(1/T). This separate documentation says 654 tablets; it is not used to change the actual mirror rows.
Primary research methods confirm 655 tablets, 1310 paired spectra, 600–1898 nm at 2 nm; active pharmaceutical ingredient prediction.

target.name: assay
target.description: Proprietary active ingredient amount per tablet
target.limitation: Molecule identity is not supplied; chemical reference values are taken from the public mirror, not independently remeasured.
